text:
QUIT CLAIM DEED

KNOW ALL MEN BY THESE PRESENTS, that WILLIAM T. ANDERSON, a single man, of Maricopa County, Arizona, for and in consideration of the sum of TEN DOLLARS ($10.00) and other valuable consideration, the receipt whereof is hereby acknowledged, does hereby remise, release and forever quit claim unto LANDMARK HOLDINGS LLC, an Arizona limited liability company, all of his right, title, interest and claim in and to the following described real property situated in Mohave County, Arizona, to-wit:

The Southeast Quarter of the Northwest Quarter (SE1/4 NW1/4) of Section 18, Township 19 North, Range 17 West, Gila and Salt River Base and Meridian, Mohave County, Arizona.

Containing 40.00 acres, more or less.

Together with all appurtenances thereunto belonging, without warranty of title.

NO REPRESENTATION IS MADE REGARDING LEGAL OR PHYSICAL ACCESS TO THE ABOVE-DESCRIBED PROPERTY. GRANTEE IS ADVISED TO CONDUCT AN INDEPENDENT ACCESS STUDY PRIOR TO CLOSING.

DATED this 7th day of April, 2026.

_________________________________
WILLIAM T. ANDERSON

anomalies.snippet: NO REPRESENTATION IS MADE REGARDING LEGAL OR PHYSICAL ACCESS
anomalies.reason: Quit-claim deed explicitly disclaims any representation of legal access. Parcel may be landlocked or require easement purchase; title insurance will not cover access defects.

anomalies.snippet: QUIT CLAIM DEED ... without warranty of title
anomalies.reason: Grantor conveys only whatever interest he has, if any. Grantee has no recourse if title turns out to be defective.
